description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'SagePayUtil' for handling interactions with SagePay, a third-party payment gateway. It includes methods to construct payment response maps, set up HTTP communication with SagePay servers, parse responses, and manage host configuration based on environment settings.

classes.name: SagePayUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for constructing payment response data, HTTP communication setup, and response parsing for SagePay payment gateway integration.

methods.name: buildCardAuthorisationPaymentResponse
methods.description: Creates a map representing the response information for a card authorization transaction, including optional fields like authorization code and message.

methods.name: buildCardCapturePaymentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a map for capturing payment responses, optionally including capture code, amount, and message.

methods.name: buildCardReleasePaymentResponse
methods.description: Builds a map for releasing (settling) payment responses, with optional details such as release code and message.

methods.name: buildCardVoidPaymentResponse
methods.description: Forms a response map for voiding (refunding) payments, including optional refund details and messages.

methods.name: buildCardRefundPaymentResponse
methods.description: Creates a response map for refunding payments with optional refund code, amount, and message.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Builds an HttpHost object based on configuration properties indicating production or testing environment.

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Parses an HttpResponse from SagePay, extracting key-value pairs from the response stream into a map.

methods.name: getHttpPost
methods.description: Creates an HttpPost request with URL-encoded parameters, ready for sending to SagePay.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Returns a new default HTTP client for sending requests.
